strapiBlog.title: Jebel Ali Public Beach Set to Become the Longest Beach in Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai continues to make waves with its ambitious urban development plans, from man-made islands like Palm Jumeirah to the world’s tallest structure, Burj Khalifa.

data.text:
Dubai continues to make waves with its ambitious urban development plans, from man-made islands like Palm Jumeirah to the world’s tallest structure, Burj Khalifa. The emirate has revealed its latest project: the longest public beach in Jebel Ali. This eco-tourism destination within the major commercial port and business hub is set to become a go-to place for beach lovers and nature enthusiasts. It features a 6.6-kilometer stretch of pristine shoreline, diverse recreational facilities, and integrated infrastructure. Let's dive deep into this latest seaside venture. Here's everything you need to know about the groundbreaking upcoming attraction in Dubai. 

About the Jebel Ali Public Beach

Dubai's Crown Prince, His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed, has approved the master plan and designs for the Jebel Ali Beach Project. The development by Nakheel aligns with Dubai's broader vision of expanding its public beaches by 400% as part of the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan. The expansive Jebel Ali Beach will be divided into three distinct areas, each offering unique features:

  • The Pearl: Located near the entrance of Palm Jebel Ali, this hub will offer beach and recreational activities, including a beach club with a private stretch of beach, children's play zones, and numerous restaurants, cafes, and shops. A floating restaurant will serve as the centerpiece of this development.
  • The Sanctuary: A haven for turtles and other wildlife, this area will emphasize environmental preservation and natural habitat.
  • The Nest: This will be a dedicated space for educational and recreational activities focusing on turtle rehabilitation. It aims to be a center of environmental studies in the city.

The design of Jebel Ali Beach is inspired by marine life, featuring elements such as coral shapes and turtle shells. This careful combination of aesthetics and functionality gives visitors a distinctive and enjoyable experience.

H.H. Sheikh Hamdan shared the objective behind Dubai's new beach at Jebel Ali. He stated, "Our focus is on creating spaces rich in beaches, open areas, and recreational greens." His Highness also said, "The ultimate goal is to enhance the well-being of the city's people, create a healthy environment for all, and make Dubai the world's best place to live in."

Facilities and Infrastructure 

The Jebel Ali Beach Development Project is about creating a vast stretch of sandy shores and integrating the natural environment. The project is situated within the Jebel Ali Wildlife Sanctuary and is listed under the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands of International Importance. Visitors will also have the unique opportunity to observe turtles in their natural habitat and take walks along the mangrove trails. The plan of enhancing turtle habitats and planting mangrove trees underscores the government’s commitment to enhancing and preserving the local ecosystems and wildlife.

Mattar Al Tayer, Dubai's commissioner general for infrastructure, urban planning, and well-being, outlined the project's features:

  • A 5km sandy beach
  • A 1.6km mangrove beach
  • A 2km open swimmable beach
  • A 2.5km diving sports area

Moreover, the latest sustainable development in Dubai will include recreational and service areas, kids' play zones, and areas dedicated to sports and marine activities. "An open beach for the public and a site of global environmental importance, the Jebel Ali Beach Development Project is the first of its kind in the UAE," he stated.

The beach will also be well-equipped with amenities to ensure a comfortable and enjoyable experience for all visitors. This includes parking for 1,000 vehicles, 80 bicycle racks, a cycling track, and a 5km running track. A floating restaurant will serve as the development's centerpiece, offering a unique dining experience.

Boosting Dubai's Real Estate and Eco-Tourism Boom

The Jebel Ali Beach Development Project significantly adds to Dubai's real estate landscape, aligning with the city's broader vision of sustainable development and urban expansion. This project not only enhances the recreational offerings of Dubai but also boosts the real estate market by creating attractive, eco-friendly living and leisure spaces.

The appeal of living near a premier beach destination will also drive up demand for residential properties in Jebel Ali and projects in Palm Jebel Ali, leading to an increase in property prices.

faqs.question: Will there be parking facilities available at Jebel Ali Open Beach?

data.answer: Yes. The beach will include integrated infrastructure, such as a two-lane road in each direction, parking for 1,000 vehicles, 80 bicycle racks, and a five-kilometer running track.

faqs.question: What will be Jebel Ali beach opening date?

data.answer: The opening date of the Jebel Ali Public Beach has not been announced yet.

faqs.question: What is Jebel Ali beach location?

data.answer: It is situated within the Jebel Ali Wildlife Sanctuary between the Palm Jebel Ali area and the Dubai-Abu Dhabi border.

faqs.question: What are the other public beaches in Dubai?

data.answer: Dubai offers several public beaches, including Jumeirah Beach with its iconic views of the Burj Al Arab, and Kite Beach, popular for water sports and activities. Other notable public beaches are La Mer Beach with its trendy atmosphere, and Sunset Beach, ideal for relaxing with picturesque views.
